title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_exploring_swift_playgrounds_by_jesse_feiler_rdm74 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_exploring_swift_playgrounds_by_jesse_feiler_rdm74' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a different machine. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by the package.
